# cb:b402 · claim-discipline

> A belief's meaning is carried by its claim and its declared deps. The reasoning from deps to claim is self-evident from the claim's wording and the deps' content. When the connection requires bridging prose, the claim is underspecified (rewrite) or the node is overcommitted (decompose into multiple beliefs).
